selected_branches.branch: Approaching a crest; obstructed-view condition; one-way exception absent by setup.

law_text: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching the crest of a grade or upon a curve in the highway where the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard in the event another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

topic_inventory.crest_or_curve: Subsection 2(a) offers crest and curve alternatives; the assigned hill_crest cell supports the crest alternative only. Curve needs a compatible cell binding owned by the batch lead.
topic_inventory.left_side: Driving to the left side is the regulated action.
topic_inventory.obstructed_view_hazard: Original driver-view obstruction and distance creating hazard if another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction remain distinct observations and judgment. No numeric hazard cutoff is supplied.
topic_inventory.one_way_exception: Subsection 3 exempts a one-way highway from subsection 2.
